name: test-agent
description: Runs the harness `testing` workflow from chat: preflight, QA suite generation from an RFC run, evaluation, upload to Kiwi for review, a prerequisites checklist, then backend, web UI (Playwright) and app UI (Maestro) execution once you have confirmed the cases in Kiwi. Command: /test-agent:test. Needs the rfc-agent plugin from the same marketplace (it runs that plugin's harness).
